metadata.title: MARES — Monitoring and Analysis of Marine Species Records
metadata.description: Platform for recording, querying and analyzing pathological data of stranded marine fauna.

authPanel.brandTitle: Collaborative monitoring of stranded marine fauna
authPanel.brandDesc: Record animals, necropsy samples and lab results. Visualize geographic and epidemiological patterns across research groups.
authPanel.brandFooter: Academic platform · access by research group

landing.heroTitle: Marine strandings, mapped and open to society
landing.heroSubtitle: MARES gathers records of marine animals stranded along the Brazilian coast — species, location and detected pathogens — in a public, browsable map.
landing.featureMapDesc: See where marine animals stranded and which pathogens were detected — no login, with filters by species, period and region.
landing.featureRecordDesc: Research groups register animals, necropsy samples and lab analyses with traceability and change history.
landing.featureOpenDesc: Darwin Core and Excel export, aligned with global biodiversity standards (SIMBA, WoRMS).
landing.footerNote: Academic project · public data on stranded marine fauna

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to MARES. By requesting access or activating your account, you agree to the terms below, which govern the use of this platform for recording and analyzing pathological data of stranded marine fauna.
terms.acceptLabel: I have read and accept the <link>Terms of Use</link>

data.title: 1. Data and purpose
data.body: The data recorded is intended for scientific research on marine fauna. Each research group is responsible for the data it enters and for ensuring authorization to collect and process it.

usage.title: 2. Platform use
usage.body: Access is personal and non-transferable. You agree to keep your credentials confidential and to use the platform only for legitimate research and conservation purposes.

privacy.title: 3. Privacy
privacy.body: We collect only the data required to operate the service (name, email and research group memberships). We do not share your personal data with third parties without a legal basis.

responsibility.title: 4. Responsibilities
responsibility.body: The accuracy of scientific data is the responsibility of whoever records it. The platform is provided as is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability.

deletion.title: 5. Profile deletion and data permanence
deletion.body: You can delete your profile at any time from the "My profile" area. Deletion removes your account data (name, email and memberships) and ends your access, but does NOT delete scientific data already published on the platform (animals, samples, analyses and research): it remains recorded to preserve scientific integrity and is no longer associated with you. If a research group is left with no members, it is deactivated, and its public data stays visible on the public map.

changes.title: 6. Changes
changes.body: These terms may be updated. When that happens, you may be asked to accept them again on your next sign-in. The date of the current version is shown at the top of this page.
